comparisons.peer_topic: Impact of ASU 2023-07 on Segment Disclosures
comparisons.peer_summary: In November 2023, the FASB issued ASU 2023-07, which enhances disclosures regarding significant segment expenses; this standard is effective for annual reporting in 2025 on a retrospective basis and will impact the company's disclosures without affecting its financial statements.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Micron disclose the adoption of FASB ASU 2023-07 regarding improvements to reportable segment disclosures. AMD completed its adoption in the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2024, whereas Micron indicates the standard is effective for its 2025 annual reporting and has not yet adopted it in 2024. Both companies identify the core topic as enhancing disclosures about significant segment expenses.

sentences.text: In November 2023, the Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB) issued Accounting Standard Update (ASU) 2023-07 Segment Reporting (Topic 280) Improvements to Reportable Segment Disclosures to enhance disclosures about significant segment expenses.
The Company adopted this standard in the fourth quarter of 2024.
In November 2023, the Financial Accounting Standards Board ("FASB") issued Accounting Standards Update ("ASU") 2023-07 (ASC Topic 280), Improvements to Reportable Segment Disclosures.
This ASU expands on existing reportable segment disclosure requirements primarily through enhanced disclosures about significant segment expenses.
This ASU is effective for our annual reporting for 2025 on a retrospective basis.

comparisons.peer_topic: Adoption of FASB Operating Segment Disclosure Standard
comparisons.peer_summary: The company is evaluating the impact of a new FASB standard issued in November 2023 requiring additional disclosures about significant expenses in operating segments, which is effective retrospectively for the annual reporting period of fiscal year 2025.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and NVIDIA address the new FASB standard issued in November 2023 requiring additional disclosures about significant expenses in operating segments. AMD reports that it adopted this standard in the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2024. In contrast, NVIDIA states it is currently evaluating the impact of the standard, which is effective for its annual reporting in fiscal year 2025, indicating it had not yet adopted it as of the end of fiscal 2024.

sentences.text: In November 2023, the Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB) issued Accounting Standard Update (ASU) 2023-07 Segment Reporting (Topic 280) Improvements to Reportable Segment Disclosures to enhance disclosures about significant segment expenses.
The Company adopted this standard in the fourth quarter of 2024.
In November 2023, the Financial Accounting Standards Board, or FASB, issued a new accounting standard to provide for additional disclosures about significant expenses in operating segments.
The standard is effective for our annual reporting for fiscal year 2025 and for interim period reporting starting in fiscal year 2026 retrospectively.
We are currently evaluating the impact of this standard on our Consolidated Financial Statements.
